analysis: Two-sided paired prompt-level method-label permutation tests of mean differences; Holm family-wise correction
unit: prompt; both responses kept together, within-response metrics and detection averaged over response slots
null_and_assumptions: Under the null, method labels are exchangeable within each paired prompt; prompts are independent sampling units. The test is not an assumption-free test of equal means. Results condition on the fixed watermark keys and sampling configuration.
monte_carlo_p: Twice the smaller one-sided tail probability, with (count+1)/(B+1) for randomized tests; capped at one
exact_rule: Enumerate all effective sign assignments when 2^number_of_nonzero_prompt_differences <= 100000; zero differences can be omitted without changing exact p-values
mc_precision: Bonferroni simultaneous 99.9% Clopper-Pearson bounds for all simulated tails; propagate p-value bounds through Holm to flag unresolved decisions
display_intervals: Existing unadjusted 95% marginal bootstrap intervals remain unchanged and do not determine corrected bolding
